messages:
Liam O'Connor: Hey folks, first day and hitting a weird thing. I completed Okta + 1Password, but when I tried to register a passkey in Okta it drops me back to the start of the flow (infinite loop) and then Drive shows 'You need access' to the shared folder 'team-data' (403). Anyone seen the passkey loop before? :confused:
it-provisioning-bot: Provisioning summary: okta_user_created liam.oconnor@redwood.com at 2026-04-14T09:05:12Z; google_account_ready at 2026-04-14T09:06:00Z; password_manager_linked.
Priya Patel: Welcome Liam! Sorry about that. Two quick checks: 1) Is the browser up-to-date and not blocking third-party cookies? 2) Can you paste the Drive folder link so I can inspect sharing?
Liam O'Connor: Browser is Chrome latest. Folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TeamDataExample. Tried in Brave too and same loop.
Maya S: Hey Liam 44b I saw a similar issue last week when Okta's passkey endpoint got a 502 intermittently. Priya, can you check logs for passkey registration errors around 09:05?
Priya Patel: Checking... I see a transient 502 from the passkey provider at 2026-04-14T09:04:50Z which caused retries. Also group promotion didn't run for a few users so that explains the Drive 403. I'll add Liam to eng-data now.
Maya S: Adding liam.oconnor@redwood.com to eng-data. Also kicked the passkey registration job to clear stale sessions. Liam, after Priya's add try an incognito window and re-register the passkey.
Liam O'Connor: Ok rechecked in incognito after the add and the Drive folder opens now  access granted. Re-registering passkey worked too  no loop. Thanks! :tada:
Liam O'Connor: One more Q: will GitHub org invite come through SSO or do I need to request it? And SSH key setup?
Maya S: GitHub invites are separate. You should get an invite email; if not ping #platform and we'll send it. For SSH: generate an ed25519 key and paste the public key into your GitHub account: 
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "liam.oconnor@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Priya Patel: Filing ticket IT-4999: "passkey-provider 502 caused onboarding loop; run catch-up and rotate session tokens". Noted manual adds for affected users.
Liam O'Connor: Appreciate the quick triage and the manual add. Everyone super helpful! :heart:
